name: cfg-router-retry-off
about: 与 cfg-router-retry-limits 相同的模型与回复，但 fallback.maxFallbacks=0（一个回退都不试）、transientRetry.enabled=false、zeroUsageRetry.enabled=false：主模型失败即结束，零用量回复不重试。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/broken
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        broken:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        fb1:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        fb2:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        zero:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        priced:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        baseline:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
router:
  enabled: true
  fallback:
    maxFallbacks: 0
    default:
      - bbx/fb1
      - bbx/fb2
  transientRetry:
    enabled: false
  zeroUsageRetry:
    enabled: false
